formula_2026.source_name: RA Law on Funded Pensions (ՀՕ-244-Ն), arlis.am consolidated edition incorporating 16.04.2026 ՀՕ-177-Ն, Art. 6 parts 2, 6, 7, 11; Art. 81 parts 8.1-8.2 (2021-2022 transitional rates)
formula_2026.evidence: Հոդված 6, մաս 2, կետ 1: «ա. 5 տոկոսի չափով, եթե աշխատավարձի ամսական չափը չի գերազանցում 500 000 դրամը, բ. 10 տոկոսի և 25 000 դրամի տարբերության չափով, եթե աշխատավարձի ամսական չափը գերազանցում է 500 000 դրամը»; մաս 6: «...«Նվազագույն ամսական աշխատավարձի մասին» ... օրենքի 1-ին հոդվածով հաշվետու ամսվա համար սահմանված չափի 15-ապատիկը գերազանցող գումարից ... սոցիալական վճարներ չեն հաշվարկվում»; մաս 7(1)(գ): «...առավելագույն ամսական շեմի 10 տոկոսի և 25 000 դրամի տարբերությունը...»
formula_2026.evidence_en: Art. 6(2)(1): a) 5% if monthly salary does not exceed 500,000; b) 10% minus 25,000 if it exceeds 500,000. Art. 6(6): no social payment on the part of monthly gross income exceeding 15x the minimum monthly wage. Art. 6(7)(1)(c): payment cannot exceed 10% of the max monthly threshold minus 25,000. With min wage 75,000 (see minimum_wage) the cap base is 1,125,000 and max payment 87,500 (computed).

value.rule: State budget tops up the accrual to 10% of monthly gross income: state part = 10% x gross - employee social payment, max 25,000 AMD/month; total accrual capped at 10% of the max monthly base (10% x 1,125,000 = 112,500 in 2026). Does NOT reduce net pay.
value.not_eligible: Voluntary joiners born before 1974 (Art. 5(1)(2)) and persons past pension age: accrual equals only their own payment (Art. 9(5)), except Art. 81(6) (born after 1964-01-01 and applied before 2018-07-01) who get the full top-up
value.income_tax_treatment: State top-up is non-taxable (Tax Code Art. 147(1)(5))

state_cofinancing.source_name: RA Law on Funded Pensions (ՀՕ-244-Ն), arlis.am consolidated edition incorporating 16.04.2026 ՀՕ-177-Ն, Art. 9 parts 2(1), 4, 5
state_cofinancing.evidence: Հոդված 9, մաս 2, կետ 1: «ամսական համախառն եկամտի 10 տոկոսի չափով՝ ... սոցիալական վճարների և 10 տոկոսը լրացնելու նպատակով ... պետական բյուջեից հատկացվող համապատասխան միջոցների (առավելագույնը 25000 դրամ) հանրագումարի չափով, բայց ոչ ավելի, քան սոցիալական վճարի հաշվարկման օբյեկտի առավելագույն ամսական շեմի 10 տոկոսը»; մաս 4: «...տարբերությունը չի կարող գերազանցել ամսական 25000 դրամը և տարեկան 300 000 դրամը»
state_cofinancing.evidence_en: Art. 9(2)(1): accrual = 10% of monthly gross income, made of the social payment plus the state-budget top-up (max 25,000), but not more than 10% of the max monthly base. Art. 9(4): difference between accrual and the person's payment cannot exceed 25,000/month and 300,000/year.
state_cofinancing.unsure_reason: Example figures are computed from the formula, not quoted.

trigger_rules: Employees with salary >= 200,001 from an employer in the November 2025 monthly income-tax report (as of 25.12.2025): pay from December 2025 salary (Art. 45(1)(3)).
Employees whose salary from an employer reaches >= 200,001 in any month Jan-Nov 2026: pay from the following month's salary (Art. 45(1)(4)).
Once triggered, premiums continue for the next 12 months regardless of salary decrease (Art. 45(1)(3)-(4)).
Thresholds are per employer ('յուրաքանչյուր գործատուից'); with several bases total payments cannot exceed the monthly rate, excess refunded (Art. 14(7)-(8)).
If the salary of a 46(9)(1) employee is insufficient in a month (incl. no salary accrued), the tax-agent employer must still pay the 4,800 (Art. 46(20)).
Social-package beneficiaries with salary up to 500,000 must themselves pay 6,000/month in addition (state does not pay the 6,000 for them) (Art. 46(17)-(18)).
Persons who also belong to state-paid groups (Art. 11(2)(1)-(10), e.g. 65+, disability) get the more favourable rule and may claim refund of paid premiums (Art. 11(3), Art. 46(16)).
Employer may pay the premium for employees (Art. 14(9)); such employer-paid UHI premiums are non-taxable income (Tax Code Art. 147(1)(29)).
For 2026, premiums are not reflected in the monthly income-tax report (Art. 46(14)); premiums are paid by the 20th of the month (Art. 46(11)).

calculation_notes: Income tax base: taxable income = gross income minus Art. 147 non-taxable items (Tax Code Art. 143(1)). The Art. 147 list contains no item for the social (pension) payment, stamp payment or the employee-paid UHI premium, so income tax is 20% of GROSS salary; the three other withholdings are computed independently on gross salary and none reduces another's base. Source: https://www.arlis.am/hy/acts/230455 (Art. 143, 147 text searched). Cross-check: iravaban.net 2026-10-18 says the premium is not deducted from the income-tax/social base.
Net pay 2026 = gross - 20% income tax (10% for qualifying R&D staff) - social payment (if participant) - stamp payment (1,000 or 15,000) - UHI premium (0 / 4,800 / 10,800).
Worked example (computed, not quoted): gross 300,000, born 1974+: income tax 60,000; pension 15,000; stamp 1,000; UHI 4,800 (if covered) -> net 219,200.

Period: income tax, social payment, stamp payment and UHI premium are all monthly, calculated by the tax agent and paid/reported by the 20th of the following month (Tax Code Art. 151(1) monthly reporting period, Art. 156(1) income-tax report by the 20th of the following month; Funded Pensions Art. 7(2); Stamp Art. 14(2); UHI Art. 46(11)).

Social payment cap is assessed on monthly gross income from ALL employers combined (Funded Pensions Art. 6(6)); stamp and UHI bands are per employer (stamp: per tax agent's monthly calculation Art. 14(1); UHI: 'ըստ յուրաքանչյուր գործատուի').

Income tax under-withheld can be recovered from the employee for at most the last three months; over-withheld amounts are offset/refunded within one month for up to three years (Tax Code Art. 152(2)).
Rounding: no rounding rule (e.g. to whole AMD) was found in the Tax Code text or the other laws fetched. UNSURE.

vat_threshold.evidence_en: Art. 59(1)(5): where one becomes a VAT payer by exceeding the AMD 115 million turnover threshold (the 'VAT threshold') during the year, VAT is computed on the part exceeding the threshold.
